name: Loro
install: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && for app in apps/mobile apps/api; do [ -f "$app/.env" ] || cp "$app/.env.example" "$app/.env"; done

terminals.name: expo-web
terminals.command: cd apps/mobile && EXPO_NO_TELEMETRY=1 npx expo start --web --port 8081
terminals.description: Expo web dev server for the mobile app. Open http://localhost:8081 to see the learner screens. Offline-first; needs no API or database to practice.
